verdict.description: Was this call about the offer above? Answer "different offer" only when the transcript positively identifies a different product. Answer "unclear" whenever you cannot tell.

evidence.description: The line from the transcript that decides it, with its [mm:ss]. When the verdict is unclear, say what was missing instead.

score.description: Did the caller control the conversation's direction, pacing, and agenda throughout? A whole number from 1 to 10, or 0 when the transcript gives no evidence to judge this.

reasoning.description: Two to four sentences justifying the Frame Ownership score, quoting the transcript. When the score is 0, say what evidence was missing.

score.description: How many layers deep did the caller go? A whole number from 1 to 10, or 0 when the transcript gives no evidence to judge this.

reasoning.description: Two to four sentences justifying the Discovery Depth score, quoting the transcript. When the score is 0, say what evidence was missing.

score.description: Were the seven buying beliefs built during the call? A whole number from 1 to 10, or 0 when the transcript gives no evidence to judge this.

reasoning.description: Two to four sentences justifying the Belief Architecture score, quoting the transcript. When the score is 0, say what evidence was missing.

score.description: Was the pitch custom-built for this prospect, and did it sell the transformation rather than the deliverables? A whole number from 1 to 10, or 0 when the transcript gives no evidence to judge this.

reasoning.description: Two to four sentences justifying the Pitch Precision score, quoting the transcript. When the score is 0, say what evidence was missing.

score.description: Could the caller hold tension without becoming needy? A whole number from 1 to 10, or 0 when the transcript gives no evidence to judge this.

reasoning.description: Two to four sentences justifying the Tension Management score, quoting the transcript. When the score is 0, say what evidence was missing.

score.description: Were objections handled in the correct sequence? A whole number from 1 to 10, or 0 when the transcript gives no evidence to judge this.

reasoning.description: Two to four sentences justifying the Objection Resolution score, quoting the transcript. When the score is 0, say what evidence was missing.

score.description: Did the caller establish early whether this is a real prospect, and act on what they found? A whole number from 1 to 10, or 0 when the transcript gives no evidence to judge this.

reasoning.description: Two to four sentences justifying the Qualification score, quoting the transcript. When the score is 0, say what evidence was missing.

score.description: Did the caller read the room and adapt in real time? A whole number from 1 to 10, or 0 when the transcript gives no evidence to judge this.

reasoning.description: Two to four sentences justifying the Strategic Awareness score, quoting the transcript. When the score is 0, say what evidence was missing.

pain_severity.description: How badly is the prospect's current situation actually hurting them? A whole number from 1 to 15, or 0 when the call never produced evidence either way.

urgency.description: Is there a reason this has to be solved now rather than in six months? A whole number from 1 to 15, or 0 when the call never produced evidence either way.

desire_clarity.description: Can the prospect describe the specific outcome they want? A whole number from 1 to 15, or 0 when the call never produced evidence either way.

solution_belief.description: Does the prospect believe this kind of solution works? A whole number from 1 to 15, or 0 when the call never produced evidence either way.

self_efficacy.description: Does the prospect believe they can execute it, while accepting they need help to do so? A whole number from 1 to 10, or 0 when the call never produced evidence either way.

authority.description: Can this person decide alone, and do the people around them back it? A whole number from 1 to 10, or 0 when the call never produced evidence either way.

financial_capacity.description: Can the prospect actually pay what this offer costs? A whole number from 1 to 10, or 0 when the call never produced evidence either way.

icp_fit.description: Is this the kind of buyer the offer is actually built for? A whole number from 1 to 10, or 0 when the call never produced evidence either way.

raised.description: Every objection the prospect voiced, whether or not it was resolved. Use the single entry None raised when none was.

primary.description: The one objection that decided the call. Null when the call closed or no objection was raised.

detail.description: One or two sentences per objection raised: the prospect's own words with its [mm:ss], and whether the caller resolved it. Empty string when none was raised.

value_leak.description: Did the caller give away consulting or strategy before getting a commitment?

follow_up_trap.description: Was a follow-up booked when a harder push was warranted?

price_drop_too_early.description: Was the price dropped before the caller confirmed the prospect was certain about the solution?

weakest_belief.description: Which of the seven beliefs was weakest or missing on this call?

best_moment.description: The single strongest move the caller made. Quote it.

biggest_miss.description: The single highest-leverage thing that could have been different. Quote it.

the_moment.description: Identify the single highest-leverage point on the call where a different move would have changed the outcome. Quote the transcript with its [mm:ss], explain what happened, what should have happened, and why it matters. Two to four sentences.

next_call_drill.description: One specific, concrete behaviour the caller can apply on their very next call. Not "work on your discovery" but "when the prospect gives a surface-level answer, say 'tell me more about that' and then wait." One or two sentences.

lead_read.description: What the lead-quality factors mean for how this prospect should be handled — written about the prospect, not the caller. Name the pattern the factors form, say what it implies for the next conversation with them, and give the one move that fits it. Two to four sentences. Where one of the listed patterns applies, use it; where none does, describe what you actually see.
